description: This file defines the interface for a Real Time Clock (RTC) helper module, including functions for printing, setting, initializing, and converting date/time data.

methods.name: printDateTime
methods.description: Prints the current date and time, probably to a console or display.

methods.name: setDateTime
methods.description: Sets the RTC to the date and time specified by the input string.

methods.name: date_set_tm
methods.description: Sets the internal date/time representation from a 'struct tm' pointer.

methods.name: date_get_tm
methods.description: Retrieves the current date/time into a 'struct tm' structure.

methods.name: dateToString
methods.description: Converts the current date/time to a string, writing to the provided buffer.

methods.name: dateToStringShort
methods.description: Converts a short version of the current date/time to a string for display, typically shorter than dateToString.
